fit_reason: Whole pickup truck listed by a private seller on Facebook Marketplace.
findings: Dull, hazy paint on the hood and front fenders with little gloss
Yellowed, cloudy headlight lenses on both sides
Dust and grime on the tailgate and rear quarter panels
Faded, chalky look on the lower two-tone tan panels along the driver side
Dirty chrome front bumper and grille guard with grime around the fog lights
Sticker and clutter visible on the dash and windshield area
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the F-350. The paint on the hood looks a bit dull and the headlights have gone cloudy, both things a pre-sale detail and headlight restoration would brighten up a lot in photos. We're a small local detailing team and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
